investigation_notes.Description: An anomalous Office 365 login from Saint Petersburg, Russia succeeded for laura.tamm@client.ee and MFA was used. The source IP 176.120.22.47 has an abuse confidence score of 100/100 and is associated with Proton66 OOO with a Data Center/Web Hosting usage type, which is more indicative of infrastructure-based hosting rather than a residential connection. The user had two earlier successful logins from Tallinn, Estonia using a different IP the same day, creating geographic inconsistency and no prior history of access from Russia. Given the high-risk IP reputation and unfamiliar country despite MFA, this activity is considered High Priority because it plausibly indicates credential misuse or unauthorized access.
